quote: On July 5, 2016, the Company completed its acquisition of certain assets primarily related to the wireless Internet of Things business ("wireless IoT business") of Broadcom Corporation ("Broadcom") pursuant to an Asset Purchase Agreement with Broadcom, dated April 28, 2016, for a total consideration of approximately $550 million.
